<!--
Criterion A
-->

```{r criterion_a_setup, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Local helpers for the Criterion A section.

# worst (most severe) RLE status from a result data frame
worst_from <- function(df) {
  if (is.null(df) || !is.data.frame(df) || !"status" %in% names(df) || nrow(df) == 0) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }
  assessment <- c(CR = 1, EN = 2, VU = 3, NT = 4, LC = 5)
  s <- df$status[df$status %in% names(assessment)]
  if (length(s) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  names(which.min(assessment[s]))
}

# normalise to a single status code, mapping invalid/missing -> "NE"
as_status_code <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0 || is.na(x[1]) || !nzchar(as.character(x[1]))) "NE"
  else as.character(x[1])
}

# format-aware status_circle (defined in parent; fall back if knit standalone)
if (!exists("status_circle")) {
  status_circle <- function(x) {
    code <- as_status_code(x)
    if (isTRUE(knitr::is_html_output())) {
      sprintf('<span class="status-circle %s">%s</span>', code, code)
    } else {
      sprintf("[%s]", code)
    }
  }
}

# colour palette shared across HTML + Word outputs
status_palette <-c(CR = "#FF0000", EN = "#FFA500", VU = "#FFFF00", NT = "#ADFF2F", LC = "#008000", NE = "black")

has_any_a <- !is.null(params$a1_result) ||
             !is.null(params$a2a_result) ||
             !is.null(params$a2b_result)
```


```{r area_table, include=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, eval = !is.null(params$areas) }
if (nrow(params$areas) > 1) {
    area_data <- params$areas
    area_data$Year <- as.numeric(area_data$Year)
    start_year <- min(area_data$Year, na.rm = TRUE)
    end_year   <- max(area_data$Year, na.rm = TRUE)
    start_area <- area_data$Area_km2[1]
    end_area   <- area_data$Area_km2[nrow(area_data)]
    change_percent <- round((end_area - start_area) / start_area * 100, 1)
  
  if (change_percent > 0) {
    trend <- "increased"
  } else if (change_percent < 0) {
    trend <- "decreased"
  } else {
    trend <- "changed"   # neutral fallback (will not say "stable")
  }
}
```

### Subcriterion assessment summary

```{r criterion_a_summary, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, eval = isTRUE(has_any_a)}
# Subcriterion outcomes "callout box".
# Restricted to the Proportional Rate of Change (PRC) results only — to switch
# to ARC, change headline_method below (and the subtitle text).
# Returns an htmltools tagList (HTML) or a flextable (Word). Returning a proper
# R object (no results='asis' with raw HTML cat()) prevents pandoc from confusing
# the chunk output with the markdown that follows.

headline_method <- "PRC"

filter_method <- function(df, m) {
  if (is.null(df) || !is.data.frame(df) || !"method" %in% names(df)) return(NULL)
  out <- df[df$method == m, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(out) == 0) NULL else out
}

a1_status  <- as_status_code(worst_from(filter_method(params$a1_result,  headline_method)))
a2a_status <- as_status_code(worst_from(filter_method(params$a2a_result, headline_method)))
a2b_status <- as_status_code(worst_from(filter_method(params$a2b_result, headline_method)))

summary_subtitle <- "Worst case across scenarios; based on Proportional Rate of Change (PRC)"

if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
  htmltools::tagList(
    htmltools::div(
      style = paste(
        "margin: 10px 0 20px 0;",
        "padding: 14px 16px;",
        "border: 1px solid #ddd;",
        "border-radius: 6px;",
        "background: #fafafa;"
      ),
      htmltools::div(
        style = "margin-bottom: 10px;",
        htmltools::tags$b("Subcriterion outcomes"),
        htmltools::tags$span(
          paste0(" \u2014 ", summary_subtitle),
          style = "color: #666; font-size: 0.9em;"
        )
      ),
      htmltools::div(
        style = "margin-top: 6px;",
        htmltools::HTML(status_circle(a1_status)), " ",
        htmltools::tags$b("A1"),
        " \u2014 Observed and inferred reduction over the past ~50 years"
      ),
      htmltools::div(
        style = "margin-top: 6px;",
        htmltools::HTML(status_circle(a2a_status)), " ",
        htmltools::tags$b("A2a"),
        " \u2014 Projected reduction over the next ~50 years"
      ),
      htmltools::div(
        style = "margin-top: 6px;",
        htmltools::HTML(status_circle(a2b_status)), " ",
        htmltools::tags$b("A2b"),
        " \u2014 Worst-case reduction over any 50-year window (including past & future)"
      )
    )
  )
} else {
  # Word: HTML divs / CSS don't render, so fall back to a coloured flextable.
  a_summary <- data.frame(
    Subcriterion = c("A1", "A2a", "A2b"),
    Description = c(
      "Observed and inferred reduction over the past ~50 years",
      "Projected reduction over the next ~50 years",
      "Worst-case reduction over any 50-year window (past + future)"
    ),
    Status = c(a1_status, a2a_status, a2b_status),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  ft <- flextable::flextable(a_summary)
  for (st in names(status_palette)) {
    rows_st <- which(a_summary$Status == st)
    if (length(rows_st) > 0) {
      ft <- flextable::bg(ft, j = "Status", i = rows_st, bg = status_palette[[st]])
    }
  }
  ft <- flextable::set_caption(
    ft,
    caption = flextable::as_paragraph(
      flextable::as_b("Subcriterion outcomes "),
      paste0("\u2014 ", summary_subtitle)
    )
  )
  flextable::autofit(flextable::theme_booktabs(ft, bold_header = TRUE))
}
```

```{r area_table_2, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=7, fig.height=5, eval = nrow(params$areas) > 1}
# This is conditional for when there is > 1 year
title_text <- "Summary of ecosystem area change"
area_change_data <- params$area_change_data

criteria_a_data <- area_change_data %>%
        mutate(area  = format(round(area, 0), big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE),
               area_change = format(round(area_change, 1), big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE),
               proportional_rate_change = round(proportional_rate_change, 2),
               absolute_rate_change = round(absolute_rate_change, 2)) %>%
   dplyr::select(!dt) %>% # remove this column
   dplyr::rename(
          `Year` = year,
          `Area (km²)` = area,
          `Area change (km²)` = area_change,
          `Proportional rate of change (%/year)` = proportional_rate_change,
          `Absolute rate of change (km²/year)` = absolute_rate_change
        )

if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
  a_tab <- htmltools::tagList(
    # # centered Title
    # htmltools::div(
    #   style = "text-align:left; font-weight:bold; font-size:18px; margin-bottom:10px;", title_text),
    # centered table too
    htmltools::div(
      style = "text-align:center;",
      htmltools::div(
        style = "display:inline-block; width:auto;",  # shrink to fit content
        DT::datatable(criteria_a_data,,
                      colnames = c("Year", "Area (km2)", "Area change (km2)",
                                   "Proportional rate of change (%)", "Absolute rate of change (km2)"),
                      options = list(paging = FALSE, searching = FALSE, info = FALSE, dom = 't'), 
                      rownames = FALSE
        )
      )
    )
  )
  
  a_tab
  
} else {
  # flextable
  set_flextable_defaults(
    font.size = 10, theme_fun = theme_vanilla, padding = 5, background.color = "transparent"
  )
  
  a_tab <- flextable(criteria_a_data) %>%
    set_caption( caption = as_paragraph(as_b(title_text))) %>%
    autofit() %>%
    flextable::theme_booktabs(bold_header = TRUE) %>%
    colformat_num(j="Year", big.mark = "") %>%
    set_table_properties(layout="autofit")
  
  a_tab
}

```

### Subcriterion details
```{r criterion_a_detail, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, eval = isTRUE(has_any_a)}
# Per-subcriterion "cards" with column-aligned rows.
# HTML  -> styled htmltools divs with status circles inline
# Word  -> single flextable with all rows + Period column + coloured Status cell

# Build a per-subcriterion data frame with consistent columns.
build_detail_rows <- function(df) {
  if (is.null(df) || !is.data.frame(df) || nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)
  period_str <- if (!is.null(df$year_start) && !is.null(df$year_end)) {
    paste0(df$year_start, "\u2013", df$year_end)
  } else {
    rep("\u2014", nrow(df))  # em dash if no period info
  }
  data.frame(
    Method     = df$method,
    Scenario   = df$scenario,
    Period     = period_str,
    `% change` = sprintf("%.1f%%", df$perc_change * 100),
    Status     = df$status,
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

sub_meta <- list(
  list(code = "A1",  desc = "Observed and inferred reduction over the past ~50 years",
       rows = build_detail_rows(params$a1_result)),
  list(code = "A2a", desc = "Projected reduction over the next ~50 years",
       rows = build_detail_rows(params$a2a_result)),
  list(code = "A2b", desc = "Worst-case reduction over any 50-year window (past + future)",
       rows = build_detail_rows(params$a2b_result))
)

if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
  # --- HTML: card per subcriterion ----------------------------------------
  # Columns: status (60px) | method (90) | scenario (110) | period (130) | % change (auto)
  grid_cols <- "60px 90px 110px 130px 1fr"
  
  make_card <- function(meta) {
    if (is.null(meta$rows) || nrow(meta$rows) == 0) return(NULL)
    
    # Column header row (inside the card, below the title bar)
    header_row <- htmltools::div(
      style = sprintf(paste(
        "display: grid;",
        "grid-template-columns: %s;",
        "gap: 12px;",
        "align-items: center;",
        "padding: 6px 14px;",
        "color: #666;",
        "font-size: 0.82em;",
        "text-transform: uppercase;",
        "letter-spacing: 0.04em;",
        "border-bottom: 1px solid #eee;"
      ), grid_cols),
      htmltools::div(""),                # status (blank header)
      htmltools::div("Method"),
      htmltools::div("Scenario"),
      htmltools::div("Period"),
      htmltools::div("% change")
    )
    
    # Data rows
    data_rows <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(meta$rows)), function(i) {
      htmltools::div(
        style = sprintf(paste(
          "display: grid;",
          "grid-template-columns: %s;",
          "gap: 12px;",
          "align-items: center;",
          "padding: 8px 14px;",
          if (i %% 2 == 0) "background: #fafafa;" else ""
        ), grid_cols),
        htmltools::HTML(status_circle(meta$rows$Status[i])),
        htmltools::div(meta$rows$Method[i]),
        htmltools::div(meta$rows$Scenario[i]),
        htmltools::div(meta$rows$Period[i]),
        htmltools::div(meta$rows$`% change`[i])
      )
    })
    
    # Card wrapper
    htmltools::div(
      style = paste(
        "margin: 12px 0;",
        "border: 1px solid #ddd;",
        "border-radius: 6px;",
        "overflow: hidden;",
        "background: white;"
      ),
      htmltools::div(
        style = paste(
          "padding: 10px 14px;",
          "background: #f0f0f0;",
          "border-bottom: 1px solid #ddd;"
        ),
        htmltools::tags$b(meta$code),
        htmltools::tags$span(
          paste0(" \u2014 ", meta$desc),
          style = "color: #555; font-size: 0.9em;"
        )
      ),
      header_row,
      do.call(htmltools::tagList, data_rows)
    )
  }
  
  cards <- Filter(Negate(is.null), lapply(sub_meta, make_card))
  htmltools::tagList(cards)
  
} else {
  # --- Word: combined flextable, coloured Status cell ----------------------
  detail_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(sub_meta, function(meta) {
    if (is.null(meta$rows) || nrow(meta$rows) == 0) return(NULL)
    cbind(Subcriterion = meta$code, meta$rows, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }))
  
  if (is.null(detail_df) || nrow(detail_df) == 0) {
    invisible(NULL)
  } else {
    ft <- flextable::flextable(detail_df)
    for (st in names(status_palette)) {
      rows_st <- which(detail_df$Status == st)
      if (length(rows_st) > 0) {
        ft <- flextable::bg(ft, j = "Status", i = rows_st, bg = status_palette[[st]])
      }
    }
    ft <- flextable::set_caption(
      ft,
      caption = flextable::as_paragraph(
        flextable::as_b("Subcriterion assessments by method (PRC + ARC) and scenario")
      )
    )
    flextable::autofit(flextable::theme_booktabs(ft, bold_header = TRUE))
  }
}
```
